description: Captaciones de agua is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Málaga. The database contains detailed information on various water abstractions in the province of Malaga. Coverage: Diputación Provincial de Málaga. The portal shows the English title as "Water catchments" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Provincial de Málaga. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/licence/CC_BY_4_0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
